functions.name: return_embedded_data_pointers
functions.contract: Return pointers to module+0x111A in A0 and module+0x005C in A1.
evidence: Existing native recovery; LEA PC-relative twice followed by RTS

functions.name: select_player_from_csd
functions.contract: Query CSD records 91 then 90; link cdi_t7g only when both queries succeed, otherwise link cdi_nodv; chain into the chosen program. The meanings of the individual CSD codes remain unassigned.
evidence: Direct instruction/control-flow reading of existing emitted source

functions.name: report_error_and_exit
functions.contract: Load the saved error word at A6-0x7FE0, call F$PErr, then call F$Exit with D1=0. The following bytes at 0x228 are a separate error-file initializer, not a return path from F$Exit.
evidence: Direct instruction/control-flow reading of existing emitted source

functions.name: find_csd_record
functions.contract: Open /nvr/csd with I$Open mode 0x41; read up to 32 bytes per line with I$ReadLn; parse a decimal record code up to colon and compare it to incoming D0.W; close the path. EOF without a match returns carry set and D1.W=0x8100; other I/O errors print diagnostics and terminate.
evidence: Direct instruction/control-flow reading of existing emitted source
